panels.description: Sanitizer-compatible navigation bus with native keyboard focus. Primary bus 0–4: Trust / Overview / Pipeline Diagnostics / Provider Health / Data Quality. Adjunct 5–6: Incident Workspace / Run Explorer. Current workspace is a non-interactive chip (aria-disabled + data-current=page, underlined) so active state is not color-only. Handoffs open same-tab, preserve current time range, and document scope reset or context mapping on cross-scope transitions. Chip colors are theme-safe for dark and light.

panels.title: Understand Incident Scope
panels.description: Explains the incident-triage question and the evidence scopes used on this read-only dashboard. CURRENT ranks suspects from current fleet telemetry using the active filters. SELECTED RUN uses HTTP-backed evidence for one exact run; run_id never filters Prometheus. No suspects means none were found in the current scope and does not prove the fleet is healthy Run coverage: IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE / UNKNOWN. Set range to run when OUT OF RANGE. Effective refresh: 60s · timezone: browser. Effective filters: provider=${provider}.

options.content:
What is the highest-confidence active suspect?
CURRENT = suspects. SELECTED RUN = proof. EMPTY DOMAIN is not a healthy-fleet verdict.

panels.title: Monitor Incident Status
panels.description: CURRENT · TIME RANGE · Pair with Provenance reason + action; never read as OK. Not a healthy OK. Ranked suspects may be WORKFLOW/GLOBAL blast radius — check scope labels on tables. Incident header status (labelled only). Map 0=OK,1=WARN,2=CRIT,3/null=UNKNOWN. Never bare numbers. Confidence from missing telemetry / VALID_EMPTY suspects. Read-only workspace

options.content: First action: open the top Ranked Suspect.

Complete per-domain evidence stays in Domain Suspect Details. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

panels.title: Inspect Selected Run Summary
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Compact pipeline_run_report_v1 projection. Expand after selecting an exact Run ID. Missing run is SELECT RUN / VALID EMPTY, not OK.

panels.title: Review Selected Run Summary
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Compact pipeline_run_report_v1 projection (identity, times, gold out, contract exclusions, coverage). Missing run is VALID EMPTY / SELECT RUN, not OK. Set range to run opens 6. Run Explorer at started_at-5m .. completed_at+5m. Do not treat CURRENT Prometheus as this UUID. Backend unavailable means the query could not be evaluated. Verify /health/live. Coverage chip is IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE / UNKNOWN from covers_selected_run. Set range to run opens Run Explorer 3022 at from_ms..to_ms. A covered run does not show an outside-range warning.

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN — no exact Run ID selected. Choose a run first. VALID EMPTY if the selected run has no report.

list.description: Optional workflow evidence context and workflow-dashboard handoff selector. Overview remains pipeline-summary-first: workflow does not yet drive exact intersection filtering for the current-status PromQL surfaces.
list.label: Workflow
list.name: workflow

list.label: Pipeline
list.name: pipeline
list.description: Core scope: pipeline option list from the local control-plane catalog (/ops/control-plane/filter-options?dimension=pipeline), not the Prometheus universe. PromQL current-state panels still match $pipeline against the shared universe metrics. Single-select unless this board documents All. Unknown is the fail-closed default until a source dashboard or the operator selects a concrete pipeline. A pasted var-pipeline value that exists in the catalog remains selectable even when Prometheus has no series.

list.label: Run Type
list.name: run_type
list.description: Core scope: run_type selector bounded by pipeline; fallback: All run types for selected pipeline. Default run_type is backfill (SEL-P0 fallback); Include All remains available for aggregate diagnostics.

Shared operator identity context sourced from the local control-plane run-manifest catalog. The selector defaults to - and affects only local HTTP identity panels; it MUST NOT be used in Prometheus labels or cross-dashboard handoffs. Run ID options are ordered by start time descending from the control-plane catalog; Grafana sort is disabled so backend order is preserved.
list.label: Run ID
list.name: run_id

list.label: Provider
list.name: provider
list.description: Provider scope: derived from Pipeline when set (first name segment, same heuristic as runtime $provider_hint), else from Workflow when set; fail-closed default is unknown when neither Pipeline nor Workflow is set. Operators may still open handoffs that pass an explicit provider value.
